messages.subject: DMRs for more than two groups (control and treatment and beyond)
messages.subject_clean: DMRs for more than two groups (control and treatment and beyond)
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr Altuna,

Good day to you. I would like to seek your advise.

I have a project with 4 groups:
Control,
Induced disease,
drugA-induced disease,
drugB-induced disease

each group with 3 biological replicates.

Any way in methylKit to support these kind of analysis simultaneously? or I should have to compare three other groups to control, respectively?

Thanks for your kind reply and help.

Best wishes,
Wai Feng

messages.body_plain:
Dear Wai,
It supports these kind of analysis but when you put all the groups at once, you will get regions where there is a difference between groups but you will not exactly know which pairs have the difference. For that you need to do pairwise comparison with methylKit.

Best
Altuna

messages.body_plain:
Thanks Dr Altuna.

I have three more questions hopefully can get your valuable opinion, Dr.

In the methylKit user guide, it suggests one can approach pool() function in the presence of replicates, so in my case biological replicates.

Q1-Could you please help me go through if my commands sequence are correct?

> file.list=list(system.file("extdata", "a_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "b_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "c_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "d_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "e_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "f_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "g_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "h_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"))

> myobj=methRead(file.list,sample.id <http://sample.id>=list("a","b","c","d","e","f","g","h"),assembly="rn6",treatment=c(1,1,1,1,0,0,0,0))

> filtered.myobj=filterByCoverage(myobj,lo.count=10,lo.perc=NULL, hi.count=NULL,hi.perc=99.9)

> norm.myobj <- normalizeCoverage(filtered.myobj, method="median")

> meth <- unite(norm.myobj, destrand=TRUE, min.per.group = 3L)

> meth

> pooled.meth <- pool(meth, sample.ids = c("test","control"))

> myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(pooled.meth, num.cores = 4)

... ...

Q2-Or I should add the tiling window analysis (i have done that before > pooled.meth <- pool(meth, sample.ids = c("test","control")) command as show above? I have tried that but seems dont have any effect, results are the same.

Q3Also, if my replicates (n) for each group is: Control (n=3), induced disease (n=3), drugA-induced disease (n=3),  drugA-induced disease (n=2), 'm I using the command correctly as shown below?

> file.list=list(system.file("extdata", "a_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "b_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "c_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "d_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "e_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "f_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"), system.file("extdata", "g_CpG.txt", package = "methylKit"))

> myobj=methRead(file.list,sample.id <http://sample.id>=list("a","b","c","d","e","f","g"),assembly="rn6",treatment=c(1,1,1,1,0,0,0))

many thanks for your time, Dr Altuna

messages.subject: "diffCpGann" & cpG info extraction
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I am using methylkit to do some differential methylation analysis.  The instructions are really clear on how to create a gene annotation object(Diiffann) and extraction these gene names with Association WithTSS().  However, i am trying to do thing to extraction gene annotation over CpG island instead of  individual bases like we get with the "Diffann" object and I am having a hard time printing the file that can show this information.  Here is my code:

diffCpGann=annotateWithFeature(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),
                                    cpg.obj$CpGi,cpg.obj$shores,
                         feature.name <http://feature.name>="CpGi",flank.name <http://flank.name>="shore")

AssociationWithTSS = getAssociationWithTSS(diffCpGann)
write.table(AssociationWithTSS, "CpGAnnotation.xls", quote=FALSE, sep="\t", col.names = NA)

It looks like getAssociationWithTSS() doesn't work for diffCpGann obgect like it does for the Diffann object.  Also I tried to use the get.Flanks() that wouldn't work either.  Does anyone have any ideas on how to extract gene  annotation over CpG island with methylkit?  Thanks.

Roxy
